96K likes, 1,085 comments - foodpharmer on October 17, 2026: "CATTLE FEED IN PRIYA GOLD BISCUITS?!

FSSAI recently inspected Priya Gold’s manufacturing facility.

They found sacks of bran marked as “Intended for cattle use,” along with reported concerns regarding hygiene and pest control.

So why were sacks labelled for cattle use found inside a biscuit manufacturing facility?

It’s time that food companies start taking accountability & not take consumers’ health for granted!

Please share this video so it reaches more Indians!

Let’s keep fighting the system & let’s make India healthy again! 

#priyagoldbiscuits".
